reviewer.statement: The plan records manual_test_gate=AUTO_ONLY for every L3 of OM9-L2-01-02, so acceptance rests on the automated checks below; no human item is requested.

oracle.negative: Observer panic/exception handled without corrupting dispatch transaction
oracle.positive: Commands emit started/progress/warn/finished typed events with monotonic ordering

checks_run: RED: there was no command-level event type at all, so the fixtures had nothing to read; the first run of tests/command_events_surface.rs was 4 passed; 1 failed (run_len('line') = 0: an event names the command by FEATURE ID, as the registry does, not by display name).
GREEN: cargo test -p om9-app --test command_events_surface -> 5 passed; 0 failed (Z1..Z4, AA1..AA4)
cargo test -p om9-app --lib: 90 passed (includes the 3 command_events unit tests, one of which proves a panicking observer is contained)
cargo test --workspace -j 2: every group ok; cargo check --workspace --all-targets: exit 0
cargo fmt --check: exit 0; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings: exit 0
title: Command Event And Observer API
code_change: command_events.rs (new, pure): EventKind { Started, Progress, Warn, Finished }, EventOutcome { Committed, Cancelled, Refused }, CommandEvent { sequence, kind, command, detail, outcome }, EventLog with a total sequence and MAX_EVENTS = 256, Observer, notify (catch_unwind, returns whether the observer survived) and notify_all (counts survivors).

session.rs: the Controller owns one EventLog and emits Started on dispatch, Progress on the first point of a two-point command, Finished(Committed|Cancelled|Refused) at the end, plus Controller::warn for a refusal inside a run.
